title: ‘His presence in our territory is unacceptable’: Women’s groups oppose Trump’s visit to PH, Pax Silica
summary: Calling the U.S. president’s presence in the Philippines “unacceptable,” women’s groups opposed Donald Trump’s upcoming visit for the ASEAN Summit, as well as the Pax Silica initiative.
